headline: FIFA World Cup 2026 — Round of 16
items: RESULT: Portugal 0-1 Spain — Mikel Merino's late winner ends Cristiano Ronaldo's final World Cup as Spain reach the quarters
RESULT: USA 1-4 Belgium — the co-hosts are knocked out as Belgium book their quarterfinal place
LIVE: Argentina 0-1 Egypt (12:00 PM ET, Atlanta) — Yasser Ibrahim strike; Messi penalty saved by Shobeir
TODAY: Switzerland vs Colombia (4:00 PM ET, Vancouver) — the last Round of 16 tie
NEXT: Quarter-finals — France vs Morocco (Thu Jul 9), Spain vs Belgium (Fri Jul 10), Norway vs England (Sat Jul 11)
GOLDEN BOOT: Messi, Mbappe & Haaland tied on 7; Mbappe leads on the assists tiebreaker
